[1/2] Graphics cycle: deterministic 64x64 wall-panel texture on material.wall, capture route and before/after pair, inspect for stretching

impact_assessment.why: Boundary walls are flat gray boxes; cover panels got seams in cycle 49 but walls still read as untextured slabs, weakening the arena enclosure at spawn and long sightlines.
impact_assessment.benefits: A material-only panel texture adds seams/bands to all four walls with no new nodes, draw calls or colliders, and keeps determinism.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: material/texture only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, save or physics change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first texture tests, a seeded wall_texture capture pair at 960x540, and a same-hash played run; keep checker_scale gentle to avoid world-block banding.

[1/2] Audio cycle: map the existing surge_forfeit event to a distinct voice and danger caption, prove with the forfeit drill, caption pair and WAV probe

impact_assessment.why: Switching away from surge silently forfeits the remaining timer and ammo; only the ordinary switch click plays, so the penalty looks like a free weapon change.
impact_assessment.benefits: A distinct 120 Hz voice and red SURGE FORFEIT caption make the lost surge time and ammo audible and visible without touching the sim.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: event/audio/caption only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, ammo or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first cue tests, a seeded forfeit capture pair, a same-hash played drill and a WAV/spectrogram probe; normal switch caption stays covered by a guard test.

Task 'shooter-cycle-57-surge-forfeit-cue' completed successfully.
[1/2] Progression cycle: surface failed profile saves in the debrief and keep an unwritable path from crashing the run; prove with a locked-profile death pair and drill

impact_assessment.why: A failed save only incremented profile_save_errors; the debrief looked normal while the run was lost, and a profile parent that cannot be created raised out of the finish.
impact_assessment.benefits: The death screen names PROFILE NOT SAVED in red, and a save-path failure loses only the run, never the crash-free finish.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: debrief draw + save error handling; dependency: none; concurrency: lock semantics unchanged; state: profile schema and sim untouched.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for the silent debrief and the crash path, a locked-profile capture pair, a same-hash save_fail drill, and the full gate set.

[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: add DATA-driven viewmodel recoil (pull back/up with existing sim.kick), capture a scatter fire frame pair and verify a same-hash played drill

impact_assessment.why: Firing adds camera kick, but the gun is rigidly camera-parented: the gun never moves relative to the view, so recoil reads as the world tilting instead of the weapon kicking.
impact_assessment.benefits: The existing kick becomes a visible weapon punch with no new nodes, draws or sim state; DATA owns the amount.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: viewmodel presentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, aim, hitbox or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first position/decay tests, a seeded scatter fire-frame pair at 960x540, and a strafe drill whose hash must not move.

[1/2] Enemies cycle: reject cover-blocked warden escort ring positions, prove with a 20-seed placement test, a platform-edge pair and a summon drill

impact_assessment.why: Warden escorts could materialize inside a cover box because summon placement clamped only to the arena bounds, leaving mites stuck in geometry.
impact_assessment.benefits: Summons now stand clear of covers, so escorts can path and threaten the player as intended.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: summon placement only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: deterministic RNG, max_alive and event count retained.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first 20-seed test, staged platform capture pair, summon drill comparing blocked positions, and full gates.
